report: Read all 17 verses end to end against the 27-lemma candidate table; every multi-treatment bucket is licensed by the ASV's own wording rather than a split in analysis.

waw: 14.8 'And when' (rule 55 pair, head on the coordinator), the 14.8 apodosis waw and the 14.13 waw between yāsap and the lexical verb both unrepresented (rules 14, 56), 14.9 Now, 14.10 for, 14.11 So, 14.16 even before ʿad (rule 16 split) — each reads the connective actually written.

Article: hā-ʾĕlōhîm → God with the article unrepresented in 14.11, 14.14, 14.15, 14.16; kol-hā-X with no the (14.17 ×2) unrepresented; [הַ] takes the written the in 14.13 and nothing in 14.12/14.15 where the ASV writes none; 14.11 הַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא → 'that place' gives that to the demonstrative and leaves both articles (rule 41). Consistent throughout.

lə before a predicate noun ('established/anointed him king', 14.2 and 14.8) unrepresented both times; dative lə silenced by a bare English indirect object (14.1 'build him', 14.4 'he had') and rendered unto where the ASV writes it (14.10, 14.14) — rule 40 read off the ASV each time.

bākāʾ → 'mulberry trees' heads on mulberry in both 14.14 and 14.15 (rule 31, palm-trees precedent); lipnê fuses to against (14.8) and before (14.15); Baal-perazim's two name tokens are aligned token by token in both 14.11 occurrences.

14.13 yāsap → again / ʿôd → yet is the one allocation a later reader might reverse (yāsap → yet, ʿôd → again reads linearly, and 14.14 gives ʿôd → again where no yāsap competes); the verse note names the competing reading under rule 8, and either allocation partitions the same two words, so it is left as accepted.

BSB disagreements are all documented convention: the five lə silenced by recasting (rule 40), the two waws above, the nine articles above, and the 14.16 directive he on Gezer, which is rule 32's own example of ʿad already carrying the to. No genuine error found.

No convention recorded: the nine repeated notes each restate a contract rule (15, 16, 19, 27/52, 29) or read a preposition off the ASV under rule 11, and none is a chapter-wide judgment a later verse would have to rediscover. No promotion or amendment: the chapter taught nothing the contract does not already say.
